source_snapshot.test_name: Leaky Bucket Setting in BIOS menu
source_snapshot.items: Leaky Bucket Setting in BIOS menu
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe, clear logs, enter BIOS, edit ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold, save and reset, collect results/photos and inspect new logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Register behavior matches expectation and the second DIMM (DIMM_B) can still trigger logs in the system and BMC SEL.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly identifies manual BIOS interaction but reduces the test to setting the threshold and observing SEL; it omits the required DIMM_B stimulus definition, register verification, system-log evidence, configuration restoration and fault-injection safety.

original_test_intent.purpose: Change the platform-approved ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold in BIOS, save/reset, verify the corresponding register behavior, then exercise the approved memory-error stimulus on the physical second DIMM (`DIMM_B`) and confirm the expected event is reported by both the system and BMC SEL.
original_test_intent.target: The exact BIOS/firmware threshold control and associated owner-defined register on the verified SUT, plus the physical DIMM_B identified by socket/channel/slot/serial mapping and its system/BMC error-reporting paths.
original_test_intent.scope: One approved test-threshold change and save/reset, readback/register verification, one owner-defined DIMM_B stimulus sequence with its specified count/timing, system and BMC SEL correlation, and documented final configuration within the 20-minute attended/20-minute machine estimates. If the signed final-state plan requires restoration and the platform applies it only after reset, that is a separate approved restoration change/save/reset after stimulus evidence is complete.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve baseline configuration/logs, have an authorized operator set the exact BIOS value and perform the single test-setting reset, verify menu persistence and register state, execute only the supplied DIMM_B error-stimulus recipe under safety controls and capture all system/BMC evidence. Then retain the value or, under a separately approved final-state step, restore the signed value and perform one additional restoration reset if the platform requires it.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The source estimates 20 attended and 20 machine minutes. The number and spacing of correctable-error events, decay window, observation timeout and repetitions are not given and must come from the exact platform recipe; the estimates do not define them.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The BIOS setting persists, the designated register follows the owner-defined expectation, the approved DIMM_B stimulus produces the specified system and BMC SEL events at the correct threshold/timing, no unrelated fault storm or instability occurs, and final configuration/health matches the owner plan.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/CPU/board/BIOS/BMC and DIMM inventory/map; exact threshold and register expectation; baseline/export/clear audit; before/after BIOS captures; reset/boot timeline; exact stimulus command/tool/operator actions and event count/timing; register readback; complete system/RAS/UEFI/BMC SEL evidence; unexpected events; restoration and final health.
ambiguities: The threshold value, valid range, associated register/field and expected register behavior are absent.
The DIMM_B physical-to-logical mapping and whether `second DIMM` means a physical population order, slot label or channel position are absent.
The correctable-error stimulus method, event count/spacing, leaky-bucket decay window and log timeout are absent.
The source requests log clearing without baseline export/authorization and does not state whether the changed threshold remains or is restored.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 preserves the BIOS change, DIMM_B stimulus, register/SEL evidence, one-reset limit and high-risk recovery controls. Its MANUAL ONLY classification underweights the meaningful automated phase: once an operator performs the BIOS action and the owner supplies a stimulus, an agent can collect and correlate register, system-log and SEL evidence. It also omits the 20/20-minute source estimates and detailed threshold timing/count handoff.

applicable_history.decision: V2 correctly prohibits invented fault injection and requires a board/DIMM-specific recipe. No later user ruling supplies the threshold, register, DIMM_B map or stimulus semantics.
A meaningful manual setup plus automated execution/evidence workflow uses REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; MANUAL ONLY is reserved for acceptance with no reasonable automated substitute.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify MANUAL ONLY to REQUIRES because the BIOS change is manual but register, system-log and BMC SEL collection/correlation are meaningful automated phases. Preserve both source criteria and require exact DIMM_B mapping plus threshold count/timing semantics before any fault stimulus.

available_now: The BIOS control name, save/reset action, register-behavior requirement, DIMM_B target and dual system/BMC logging requirement are explicit.
Read-only SUT/DIMM inventory, firmware/configuration and existing log baselines can be collected before state change or injection.
missing_inputs: The BIOS/platform owner must supply the exact supported threshold value/range, menu path, register/field/read method, expected state and final restoration policy.
The memory/RAS owner must supply the exact DIMM_B socket/channel/slot/serial mapping, correctable-error stimulus tool/procedure, count/spacing/decay/timeout and expected system/SEL records.
The lab owner must provide package/tool entitlement, dedicated window, backup, console/OOB recovery, log-baseline policy, stop limits and explicit fault-injection/reset approval.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BIOS/platform owner supplies setting/register semantics; the memory/RAS owner supplies DIMM mapping, stimulus and acceptance; the lab/system owner supplies tools, authorization, monitoring and recovery.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record SUT/CPU/board/BIOS/BMC/OS, SMBIOS and full DIMM slot/serial population, current BIOS threshold if safely readable, system health and complete system/BMC logs without clearing them.
Validate package/version/hash and draft the DIMM_B evidence mapping without injecting an error, changing BIOS, resetting or clearing logs.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not guess threshold/register/DIMM_B identity, edit BIOS, reset, inject memory errors, clear unexported logs, assume a vendor/platform from the term leaky bucket, reuse another system's threshold, repeat events automatically, continue a fault storm or claim PASS from BIOS persistence/SEL alone.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Sign off the exact platform setting/register, physical DIMM_B map, bounded stimulus count/timing and expected dual-path logs; preserve/export baseline; prove console/recovery and stop controls; approve one stimulus run; reconcile configuration/register/events/timestamps; then retain the test value or execute a separately approved restoration change/reset and verify final state.

revision_candidate.test_name: ECC Leaky-Bucket BIOS Threshold and DIMM_B Event Logging
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify the approved ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold setting and register behavior and confirm that the approved DIMM_B stimulus produces the specified system and BMC SEL events.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server board, CPU/memory controller, BIOS/BMC/firmware and DIMM population supported by the owner RAS recipe, with authorized BIOS console, vendor injection tool if required and isolated recovery-capable SUT.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One exact BIOS threshold/register and one physically mapped DIMM_B, one approved test-setting save/reset and one bounded owner-defined stimulus sequence. If final-state policy requires restoring the original threshold, permit one separately approved restoration save/reset after evidence collection. Preserve 20 attended/20 machine minutes as planning estimates, not event count, decay or timeout definitions.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SUT/firmware identity; threshold value/range/menu and register field/read method; DIMM_B socket/channel/slot/serial map; correctable-error type and injection tool/recipe; count/spacing/decay/timeout; expected system and SEL records; baseline/log-clear policy; backups; final-setting policy; authorization; stops and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Export and hash BIOS/configuration plus system/BMC logs before an approved clear, or use an approved timestamp marker. An operator enters BIOS, sets the exact threshold, saves and performs the single test-setting reset. Verify boot, menu persistence and register state. Run only the bounded approved DIMM_B stimulus while monitoring health, collect complete system/RAS/UEFI and BMC SEL evidence and correlate count/timing/decay behavior. Retain the value if required; otherwise, only after stimulus evidence is complete, perform a separately approved restoration change/save/reset and verify the restored value and health.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct platform/BIOS and physical DIMM_B mapping verified; threshold/register/stimulus criteria supplied; controlled tool/package ready; backups and logs preserved; no production workload; console/OOB, monitoring/storage and recovery proven; operator, reset, BIOS-change and fault-injection approvals recorded.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/versions and physical/logical DIMM map; signed threshold/register/stimulus rules; baseline export or marker and any clear audit; pre/post BIOS screenshots; exact save/reset/boot timeline; register readback; injection tool/command/hash, target, event count/spacing/status; system RAS/UEFI/kernel logs and BMC SEL with timestamps; unexpected events; final setting/configuration and health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved BIOS/memory-RAS recipe for the exact platform, constrained by source criteria that register behavior matches expectation and DIMM_B still triggers the specified event in both the system and BMC SEL.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Dedicated approved SUT only. Do not infer vendor semantics or threshold values, target an unmapped DIMM, inject an unapproved error, clear unexported logs, repeat automatically, exceed count/time/health stops, suppress an event storm, continue after instability or improvise reset/recovery.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Explicit approval is required for the test-threshold BIOS change/save/reset, log clear, fault injection, exact threshold/count/timing and final-setting disposition. If restoration requires another change/save/reset, authorize that separately after the stimulus result is preserved. A qualified operator performs BIOS interaction; the RAS owner authorizes and judges the stimulus.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The operator performs BIOS navigation/value change and any physically mediated stimulus. Automation may inventory, supervise a supplied injection command, read an approved register and collect/correlate system and BMC logs; engineers resolve platform-specific register and event semantics.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On no-boot, instability, wrong target/register, unexpected reset, event storm or tool fault, stop injection, preserve all partial logs/configuration and use approved console/OOB recovery. Restore the signed BIOS value only under owner direction with a separately authorized restoration reset if required; this is recovery/finalization, not an automatic rerun of the stimulus.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong platform/DIMM/register/tool; absent criteria/map/approval/recovery; failed baseline preservation; setting does not persist; no-boot; monitor/output loss; unexpected correctable/uncorrectable event, fault storm, machine check, reset, memory/thermal/power instability; mismatched system/SEL identity/timing; or failed final restoration/health.

identified_defects: DeepSeek omits the exact DIMM_B stimulus, register behavior and system-log half of the criteria.
The source lacks threshold/register semantics, physical DIMM_B mapping, event count/timing/decay and fault-injection method.
V2 treats a hybrid BIOS setup plus automated register/log correlation as MANUAL ONLY despite the V3 hybrid boundary.
V2 does not preserve the 20/20-minute facts or explicitly prevent another platform's leaky-bucket semantics from being reused.
reason_for_change: Preserve the complete two-stage BIOS-plus-DIMM_B RAS intent, classify the meaningful automated evidence phase correctly and prevent platform-specific threshold or fault-stimulus assumptions from causing unsafe or false validation.

new_technical_evidence.title: Memory Replacement Guideline and Advanced Memory Test for DSG Commercial Platform Server BIOS Technical Paper
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Conceptual evidence only; the target CPU/platform vendor is unknown and Intel values must not be applied to it
new_technical_evidence.supports: A memory correctable-error threshold can be implemented with leaky-bucket counters whose grouping and decay depend on platform settings and DRAM operation, so event count, mapping and observation timing must come from the exact recipe.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The target platform, register, threshold range, DIMM mapping and decay behavior remain unconfirmed.

new_technical_evidence.title: DGX Station A100 System Firmware Changes
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Evidence of platform/firmware specificity only; not an assertion that the SUT is DGX Station A100
new_technical_evidence.supports: NVIDIA documents a firmware-specific mismatch between displayed ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold range and actual default, reinforcing that generic menu text is not a portable acceptance reference.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: No target model or firmware version is supplied, so this release note cannot define the test value.

removed_ambiguities: Separates BIOS edit/persistence, register behavior and DIMM_B dual-log behavior as distinct required evidence.
Requires a physical-to-logical DIMM_B map and recipe-defined event count/timing/decay instead of interpreting `second DIMM` by enumeration order.
Treats 20/20 minutes as planning values rather than an injection or timeout rule.
Defines whether the threshold is restored or retained as an owner decision rather than an implicit end state.
resolved_blockers: Manual BIOS interaction does not prevent automated register/system/SEL evidence collection; the complete hybrid workflow is REQUIRES rather than MANUAL ONLY or BLOCKED.
Safe inventory and baseline collection can proceed before fault-injection approval.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits exact threshold/register semantics, DIMM_B mapping, bounded vendor-approved stimulus, expected dual-path events, log policy, authorization and recovery.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 applies the hybrid capability boundary, preserves both source acceptance paths and closes platform, DIMM identity and event-timing gaps that could otherwise validate the wrong memory target or accept BIOS persistence without RAS behavior.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The first validator pass found a TEST_CASE_DOCUMENT_DEFECT: one-reset scope conflicted with optional restoration that may require another reset. V3 now separates the single test-setting save/reset from one separately approved restoration save/reset after stimulus evidence, only if the signed final-state policy requires it. Revalidation recovered the exact threshold/register, mapped DIMM_B, bounded stimulus, count/timing/decay, system plus SEL evidence and final health; no material document defect remains.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 3 changes ECC Leaky Bucket Threshold in BIOS, saves/resets, requires expected register behavior and DIMM_B events in both system and BMC SEL, with 20/20-minute estimates.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 preserves the two-stage intent and safety but classifies the entire hybrid workflow MANUAL ONLY and omits exact count/timing/decay handoff.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow identity/DIMM-map/config/log baselines; prohibit BIOS change, reset, injection or log clear until the exact platform recipe, approvals, stops and recovery are supplied.
